verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an inference runtime, with on-device SDKs and a hosted Wally cloud, so multi-GPU distribution is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism. The closest items are single-device acceleration (Hexagon NPU, Metal on M3) and hosted cloud models running on RunAnywhere's own hardware, neither of which is a developer-controlled multi-GPU capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
